text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Fini—hm? M-my feet! Oh no, did a shark bite me?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ah... Aaaahhh! T-Trainer, tell me,
do I
still have legs?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-they feel weird, but I'm too scared to
look! They feel all slimey...
Are my feet
inside the shark's mouth?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Seaweed?! Ah, you're right, it's all over
me... Uurgh... I just jumped to
conclusions
again...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I caused a real scene,
didn't I? Ah,
b-but I think I cleared the
time you
wanted me to reach... right?

We're about halfway through the
academy's summer camp. Doto might not
have changed much in terms of demeanor,
but her racing
skills are steadily improving.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, I still have a long ways to go!
B-but if
by some chance—some
miracle—I did
improve...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Then it would definitely be thanks to your
guidance! Th-thank you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
What?! N-no, I-I'm telling you, I'm just
stubborn... It's all thanks to
your clear
instructions.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Th-that's not—I-I only do well
because you're so serious about
training
me!

Somehow, we've started a never-ending
compliment cycle. Still, this is
a good
chance for me to boost Doto's confidence,
so I continue...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Aaauuugh! P-p-p-please... stop! I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
R-regardless, I can't take it anymore...
Please... I've never been
complimented this
much before... Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But...
it's nice to know you believe in me so
much...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I wish I could... thank you somehow...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah... I-I'll get back to running!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
M-more seaweed?! I-I'm going to slip and
faaaall!

Once our training for the day is finished,
Meisho Doto and I part
ways, and I make
my way back to the dorms alone... Or so I
think.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
OW! Urgh... Where did that... pillar come
from...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eyah! Ah, y-yes! Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... N-not really, but... maybe? I don't need anything, but... um...

Doto struggles to find the words she
needs, but I know she'll get there. I wait
patiently as she gathers the courage
needed to make her
request.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-UM!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I know this might be just a bother for
you... a-and we might end up
in a huge
mess because of me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-In fact, worst-case scenario,
we could get
caught up in an explosion,
and the
resulting shockwave would—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um...
I-I want to see the fireworks! S-so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: C-come with me... p-pleashe...

It's been several hours since I accepted
Meisho Doto's unexpected invite. We left
for the fireworks shortly after, with Doto
leading the
way, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
AAAAHHHHH! The fireworks are probably
o-over by now...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
this is all because I got lost...
And then I was almost
kidnapped by that
owl…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... But no matter what happened, you
never turned back... We
just kept going,
but now that we're finally here...
Nothing.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I saw online that this place is perfect
for viewing the fireworks... Not
a lot of people
know about it, so you're guaranteed to get
a good view...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why I even try. I'm a walking
disaster... No matter how
hard I try, things
never work out right...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I really, really wanted to make you happy
too...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but there's no fireworks.
You did all that
walking just to stare at an
empty sky...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I just ended up wasting your time again.
I-I'm so—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yes?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I... Urgh... Trainer!

Sure, we missed the fireworks, but Doto
showed me how much she cares. Just as I'm
about to suggest we see the fireworks
some other
time...
Boom...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah! Ah...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? Fireworks? I-I thought they would
be over by now...

A quick search on my smartphone reveals
that they were delayed due
to an
unspecified setback.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-you think so? Does that mean... my
clumsiness was useful?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wh-what am I saying?! Of course not!
I-I promise I'll be more
careful going
forward! But...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...
I'm glad I did all that research. ♪

As Meisho Doto looks up to the sky, the
light from the fireworks
reflects in her
tears, making her sparkle in turn.

Maybe... just maybe, she's gained a little
confidence after today.
